util

Class Separator

  • java.lang.Object
    • util.Separator

  • public final class Separator
extends java.lang.Object

    Provides a stateful utility for joining textual elements into a single delimited string. It eliminates the "trailing delimiter" problem by managing its own internal state.

    This class is designed to be used directly within StringBuilder.append() calls. The first call to toString() returns an empty string, while subsequent calls return the specified delimiter. This allows for a clean loop implementation without conditional logic for the first or last element. 

     Separator sep = new Separator(", ");
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 for (String item : list)
 {
     sb.append(sep).append(item);
 }
